data.content_ref: inline:SRC_001 makes an explicit barrier/suspend event a necessary condition ('if and only if') for safe resumption, but append-only identity is preserved whenever the last recorded event was fully persisted before exhaustion, even if no barrier/suspend marker was emitted. A run that exhausts the budget cleanly after a completed event has a complete, uncorrupted event log; continuing with the same causal fingerprint from that committed boundary would not inject a new identity. By refusing all such cases, the target over-constrains the permissible-resumption set and fails to determine exactly when resumption may occur.
